text:
ana (AE): Quick heads-upFinReg Co asked for a vendor-risk bundle for their PoC: EU-only dataflow diagram, full subprocessor list with SCC status, retention windows, and KMS options. They need it within 48h.

sam (Security): Clarify PoC env? Hosted API or Dedicated? Any BYOK request? Also what data classes (PII, transaction ids)?

mike (Solutions): PoC on Hosted API initially; may move to Dedicated. Payloads: user IDs, transaction metadata, no raw payment files. No BYOK initially but they may request BYOK for Dedicated.

ilana (Product): We can promise region routing to eu-west endpoints and option for Dedicated in an EU-only VPC. Logs/metrics live in configured region; need to call out retention options.

sam (Security): Diagram should show ingress -> region router -> inference pool (ephemeral KV cache) -> model runtime -> response. Sidecars: metrics (monitoring), object store (backups), secrets/KMS. Mark where encryption in-transit and at-rest applies.

mike (Solutions): I'll produce a two-panel diagram PNG and a plain ASCII snippet for their docs. Will include notes: cache TTL, no persistent raw payload storage, and redaction in traces.

confluence-bot: page created: /security/finreg-poc (masked link)

ana (ops-bot): (ignore accidental bot message)

ana (AE): Please include explicit retention defaults: request logs 7d (can shorten), aggregated metrics 90d, and option to disable logs for enterprise. Also include statement that we do not send model weights or training data upstream.

sam (Security): For subprocessors list: cloud compute (region-limited), S3-compatible object store for backups, monitoring (Datadog or EU alternative), error telemetry (Sentry), and any third-party quantization tooling. Note SCCs and whether vendor processes EU data.

mike (Solutions): I have a living subprocessor CSV on Confluence; will export and annotate EU-handling and SCC status. Link will be in the bundle.

ilana (Product): Add a short paragraph on routing & fallback: policy-based routing (eu-only), automatic fallback to compatible model variants (same residency), and Dedicated peering option.

sam (Security): Key mgmt note: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated (BYOK/HSM) and have enterprise KMS integrations for Hosted upon contract. Add SOC2 + ISO artifacts list and pen-test summary.

mike (Solutions): Minimal ASCII snippet for buyer doc:

Client (EU) -> HTTPS -> Region Router (eu-only) -> Inference Pool (ephemeral KV cache) -> Response
                     |-> Metrics -> Monitoring subprocessor (EU region)
                     |-> Backups -> S3-compatible (EU bucket, encrypted)

ana (AE): Great. Can you own the artifacts? I'll package and send after review.

mike (Solutions): I'll upload draft bundle (diagram PNG, ASCII snippet, annotated subprocessor CSV, short narrative) to Confluence and ping here. Target: 12h for draft.

sam (Security): I'll review and tighten retention wording. Also include signed statement template for their vendor intake.

ana (AE): Thanks team I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough with their InfoSec after we hand off.

mike (Solutions): Draft uploaded, pinging reviewers.

confluence-bot: page updated: /security/finreg-poc (masked link)

sam (Security): Reviewing now, will finalize by EOD.

ana (AE): Deadline 48h. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
